message:
I've successfully resolved the Aurora-beam synchronization defect in the Lucky Card Reveal sequence. The core issues stemmed from stale DOM targeting (canvas aiming at pre-animation coordinates) and linear Bezier control points that created straight 'laser' lines instead of magic ribbons.

To correct this, I implemented a new `strikeTargetsRef` that discretely captures the true, animated position of the card at the exact moment each strike begins, ensuring 100% targeting accuracy without expensive per-frame polling. I also introduced organic, horizontally bowed Bezier control points to replace the linear sweeps, yielding elegant, curving aurora energy. Finally, the beam and impact shockwaves were shifted to the foreground canvas (`fgCtx`), ensuring they visibly strike *over* the card, respecting proper 3D layering constraints without altering the core artwork or timing.
